name: Golf & Co (Golf Group)
description: TASE-listed Israeli retail group (listed since 2006) that designs and sells apparel and home goods, best known for the Golf&Co home-design chain; it operated about 326 stores across Israel as of 2019.
notes: No current agency or marketing head found in trade press; CEO Eyal Greenberg per he.wikipedia. 2025 collection with the Israel Nature and Parks Authority (Maariv).
